news.title: Medical College of Wisconsin Names Nationally Recognized Surgeon-Scientist Genevieve Boland, MD, PhD, Next Chair of Surgery
news.summary_en: In this key leadership role, Dr. Boland will oversee one of MCW's largest academic departments and lead efforts to advance excellence and a culture of collaboration across each of the institution’s missions. Her term began on September 1, 2026.
